devices.name: 00 Modular Cloct
devices.tagline: 10HP Eurorack clock and modulation source that splits one rate into eight outputs at ratios from ÷32 to ×32

devices.name: FREEPOET Plinky 4X
devices.tagline: Large-format Plinky with four times the touch area, a 2.23-inch OLED and a built-in battery

entries.name: Paradox
entries.summary: Eight-voice cross-coupled FM and ring-modulation feedback synth with an eight-voice stereo exponential reverb and leveler for the Alchemy Lab V2, after a Reaktor ensemble by Lazyfish.

entries.name: AURA-1
entries.summary: Generative ambient firmware modified from AMB-1, adding a Solo Mode for playing polyphonic synth over the generated music and a Random World patch generator.

entries.name: AURORA
entries.summary: Generative ambient firmware that plays itself: pads, bells, drone, wind and soft drums over a very large reverb, under an aurora drawn on the screen, with a keyboard that plays pads, bells or a choir.

entries.name: Contagion
entries.summary: Eight-voice dual-core wavetable synth for the FM-1 with 64 oscillator waveforms, four controls per page, 16 USER patches with SysEx backup, and three images that carry the Access Virus A, B or C factory preset collectio…

entries.name: Cozy FM-1 Games
entries.summary: Rights warning: ten-game arcade firmware for the FM-1 (Snake, Tetris, Arkanoid, OutRun, Synth Hero, Frogger, Galaga, Pac-Man, Dino Run, Flappy Bird) built on Dinghy, with chiptune music and high scores saved to flash.

entries.name: FIKH-S
entries.summary: Experimental drone and texture synth for the FM-1 with 22 algorithms in three banks, a filter, a metallic or diffuse delay with a frequency shifter, an ambient reverb with five modes, snapshots and a freeze.

entries.name: FM1_GTA
entries.summary: Top-down open-world crime game, Out on Parole, with story missions, police chases, a four-station synth radio and key LEDs that act as a lightbar and speedometer.

entries.name: FM1_GTA Network
entries.summary: Wi-Fi multiplayer build of FM1_GTA for two to four FM-1s with no router: other players appear in the city, can shoot each other, and one can play police.

entries.name: fm1-m1
entries.summary: Korg M1 sound module for the FM-1 that plays the M1's 100 factory programs and three drum kits, with effects, from a data file you make from your own M1's ROM dumps.

entries.name: Isle of Bears
entries.summary: Two-player stacking card game, Isle of Bears, played against the computer on the FM-1's screen, keys and speaker.

entries.name: Loom (Hi-Fi-Hopes)
entries.summary: Wavetable groovebox test build on fm1-base: a six-voice dual-wavetable synth, four synth drums and a pattern and song sequencer, so far run only in the simulator and browser emulator.

entries.name: MDMA
entries.summary: Performance firmware with six toggled layers, four scenes for each city preset and a 16-step drum sequencer, plus a browser page that backs up and restores the cities.

entries.name: mvave-hub
entries.summary: Browser workbench that auditions community FM-1 and SMK-37 firmware on an on-screen faceplate and installs .fwsc packages over Web MIDI after a verified backup, with a calibration and Bluetooth repair wizard for the SMK…

entries.name: Noeulim
entries.summary: Ambient firmware that plays itself: six ink-wash landscapes whose movement (a wave, snow, rain, a bamboo leaf) becomes the notes, with five tracks, a mixer, effects and 36 instruments. Source preview; no release is publ…

entries.name: nullwave
entries.summary: Six-channel groovebox for the FM-1 where any channel can be a synth, drum kit, sampler or granular voice, with per-channel sequencers, scenes chained into songs, punch-in effects and USB, TRS and Bluetooth MIDI.

entries.name: Ouroloops
entries.summary: Boss-style three-track loop station that runs in a browser on a phone or computer, with the FM-1 as its controller, second screen and audio output through the project's own control-surface firmware.

entries.name: Ouroloops firmware
entries.summary: Control-surface build of fm1-sampler that turns the FM-1 into the controller, second screen and audio output of the Ouroloops web looper, with dimmable button lights added.

entries.name: Percolator
entries.summary: 23-track percussion sequencer on the Synthesis ToolKit's PhISEM Shakers models, with per-step locks, probability and ratchets, songs, effects, MIDI sync and screen-reader support.

entries.name: PHEBUS
entries.summary: Groovebox firmware forked from KARMA, with three melodic voices, 16 editable drum sounds and 22 effect pads that stutter, reverse and sweep the whole mix.

entries.name: USB
entries.summary: Experimental firmware that takes two stereo USB audio sources and routes USB MIDI from each input to any set of output ports.

entries.name: Viscera
entries.summary: Overdubbing four-track tape looper for the FM-1 in the spirit of a Portastudio, with a mixer, bounce, a resonant filterbank, tape wear, a splice mode, lo-fi delay and verb, and a browser emulator and installer.

entries.name: FM-1 Again SMK-37
entries.summary: Port of the FM-1 Again groove firmware to the SMK-37 Pro and MKE-P37, with Ableton Link and MIDI over Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. An early version: the pads, faders and wheels are not mapped yet.

entries.name: SMK-37 Firmware Manager
entries.summary: Android app that installs community and official firmware packages on an SMK-37, MKE-P37, Starrykey 37 Play or FM-1 over USB-MIDI, with genkigenki's SMK-37 catalog built in.

entries.name: Ocarina 3DS
entries.summary: Free homebrew wind synth and looper for the 3DS and 2DS family, played with the buttons and shaped by blowing into the microphone, with 23 voices, scale lock and three loop bubbles.

entries.name: Qew
entries.summary: PSP homebrew that makes the console a USB-MIDI controller for the Mixxx DJ software, with two-deck transport, mixer, hotcue, loop, library and effect pages and deck feedback on the PSP screen.

entries.name: Frost
entries.summary: Alternative firmware for the Valeton GP-5 with a six-slot editable signal chain, 62 effect and amp types, converted NAM captures, cabinet IRs, setlists, USB audio and MIDI, and a browser editor and installer. Built on O…
